column1: # Stand-in predicate features until the lexicon (W3) carries feat vol=± and asp= on its rows (IR-REQUESTS).
# vol: - for predicates that no one does on purpose (ため → 때문에, ように → 도록); default + for verbs.
# asp: what ている means: state (知っている → 알다), change (座っている → 앉아 있다), change-past
# (結婚している → 결혼했다), activity (default: 読んでいる → 읽고 있다).
# pclass: motion (てくる → -어 오다, て → -어서), speech, emotion, perception.
